name: call_linfit_omitted_b_and_r2
source:
{ Two trailing outputs omitted at once: only the slope is kept, so LinFit's
  intercept and r2 both become hidden sinks. The reported equation/variable
  balance stays honest because Java subtracts a sink's equation as well as its
  variable (surfacedEqs = equations - (allVars - surfacedVars)). }
x = [0, 1, 2, 3]
y = [1, 3, 5, 7]
CALL LinFit(x, y : m)
